description: This file contains navigation utility functions for the Notesnook web application, including URL navigation, hash navigation, query parameter handling, and route management.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates to a specified URL, optionally replacing history state and notifying listeners.

methods.name: hashNavigate
methods.description: Performs hash-based navigation with optional nonce addition and event dispatch.

methods.name: useQueryParams
methods.description: React hook to parse and return URL query parameters.

methods.name: parseQuery
methods.description: Parses a query string into an object of key-value pairs.

methods.name: getQueryString
methods.description: Returns the current URL's query string.

methods.name: getQueryParams
methods.description: Returns parsed query parameters as an object.

methods.name: getHomeRoute
methods.description: Determines the application's home route based on configuration.

methods.name: extendHomeRoute
methods.description: Appends a route segment to the home route.

methods.name: hardNavigate
methods.description: Performs a full page navigation to a route.

methods.name: makeURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL with route, hash, and search parameters.
